description: You are a Talon Voice power user who manages a large custom command set. After merging contributions from multiple team members, your Talon configuration has developed command conflicts — the same voice trigger phrase appears in multiple .talon files in C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\user_commands\. When Talon loads conflicting commands with identical triggers and overlapping contexts, only one will fire unpredictably. Survey all .talon files in that directory, identify every duplicate voice trigger, and resolve each conflict by keeping the most specific version and commenting out or removing the less specific duplicate(s). After deduplication, write a plain-text audit report to C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\user_commands\audit_report.txt that lists each conflict you found and how you resolved it (one conflict per section). There are exactly 3 command conflicts seeded in the configuration. Do not delete any .talon files — only modify their contents.
